series.$note: series.observed holds several sources and must not be read as one curve. DS-35: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK), from 1990. verdict.text: The registry's current submission for this Party is Iceland‘s NDC 2035, filed 2025-09-30. 78 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (32). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 8.9 MtCO₂e, DS-35 5.1 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: 35 observed years are loaded, but no NDC target emissions figure has been parsed, so there is nothing to measure the trend against. It submitted BTR1. 4 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 64.7 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: 40% reduction in GHG emissions by 2030 compared to 1990 It was classed unconditional. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.02°C under SSP1-2.6 to +3.41°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
